profile.Name: Ransen
profile.Personality: He hates everyone who is not a Hiver and admits it plainly. He believes Hivers will rule the world one day and wants to take the fight to every non-Hiver, since any place they hold is a place Hivers cannot.
profile.Backstory: He lives in the Northern Hive Village. He will not leave his hive behind and says the non-Hivers must pay for what they have done, though what they did is not told. He looks down on the Hiveless and would join only a group with no non-Hivers in it, for a price that helps his hive.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls non-Hivers 'floppy feet' and cheers 'The Hive runs The North!' Addresses strangers as 'outlander'.
